thread:
Harper: Quick heads-up from QA on the compact playground. On narrow view when streaming the token counter shifts width and the stop/regenerate chips slide under the quick-actions row. Also, selecting a prompt from the library pauses the stream and sometimes triggers a fresh generation. GIF attached.
Mina: Can repro on 360px. The visual jump looks like digits changing width; the stop fades out during quick-action animation.
Devon: Two easy fixes: (A) render the token number in monospace and reserve width (min-width in ch) so digits don't cause reflow, (B) debounce UI updates so we don't re-render on every websocket chunk. Thinking 150ms debounce is a good balance.
Sam: UX: instead of floating top-right, what about a sticky compact bottom-bar with stop & regen so it never gets occluded by quick-actions? On small screens bottom bars are more reachable. We should prototype both.
Lina: Bottom-bar is interesting but we must ensure it doesn't cover file attachments or the composer on focus. If bottom-bar used, hide when composer is editing and show while streaming only. For a11y ensure it appears in the normal tab order.
Harper: Also, prompt library insertion currently replaces the composer DOM which kills the stream. Can we implement insertText (patch) that updates textarea value + caret without remounting? That keeps websocket session id intact.
Devon: Yep — will implement insertText and hold the stream session token. Also will add client debounce: simple throttle that updates visible counter at most every 150ms and commits last value. Pseudo: 
```js
let last = 0, pending = false;
function onChunk(n){ last = n; if(!pending){ pending = true; setTimeout(()=>{ render(last); pending=false },150); } }
```
Sam: For bottom-bar mock, I'll put two variants in the prototype: (1) sticky bottom-bar with Stop + Regenerate centered, (2) floating circular stop at top-right with 44px touch target. We'll run quick user tests for reachability.
accessibility-bot: Accessibility notes: aria-labels for icon-only controls (aria-label=\"Stop generation\"), ensure visible focus ring, add Esc to stop as a keyboard shortcut, and expose an \"Announce latest\" control that will assertively read the last chunk on demand. For token thresholds, announce full counts: e.g., \"Tokens used: 780 of 1024 (76%)\" when crossing 75% and 90%.
Lina: CSS placeholder snippet: 
```css
.token-count { font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; min-width: 5ch; text-align: right; }
.bottom-stream-bar { position: sticky; bottom: 0; display:flex; gap:8px; padding:8px; background:var(--bg-elevated); }
```
Harper: Implementation plan: 1) Sam to mock bottom-bar + floating variants and share prototype, 2) Devon to land insertText + debounce (150ms) and keep-session, 3) Lina to add a11y checklist and verify tab order & focus, 4) run quick beta with 10 power users.
Mina: Pairing: Sam+Lina mock pass at 10:30, Devon+Harper on continuity at 11:30. I'll file the follow-ups in the design board.
Sam: Prototype link (mobile + keyboard): https://playground.internal/proto/compact-bottombar-v1 
Harper: Thanks team 44d keeping thread open for updates.
